mathematics.conventions: Scalar windows contain 24 terms. Original parameter windows n=0..23; secancy columns k=1..8 begin at n=k; theta columns k=1..12 begin at n=ceil(k/2); theta specializations x=1..12 begin at n=0. Source degrees: reciprocal/CE/secancy Nn; tangent N(n+1)-1; Appell n; classical section Nn+j; theta 2n. Polynomial coefficients are ordinary coefficients, without k! scaling. Rational components are reduced with positive denominators. OEIS positions are export positions, not mathematical offsets. Additional tables retain all complete rows n=0..12. Ordinary triangle j=n(n+1)/2+k; theta j=n^2+k. Supported Appell column local n selects polynomial row Nn+k. Block-Appell tables use the positive j=0 block denominator; signs are retained. No zero coefficients are removed from tables. Ordinary k-step families use n; ten standard k-bonacci records store 48 values including k-1 zero seeds. Finite hypergeometric cutoff is applied before any cancellation.
